messages.content: Resume an internal architecture RFC.
Resuming an internal architecture RFC now.
How is an internal architecture RFC going?
We haven't done shortening to the eight-page limit yet.
Next steps for an internal architecture RFC?
CI is passing. The related work section covering twelve papers has shipped.
Anything broken?
Spotted a stale results table from an earlier run today. The team picked releasing the corpus alongside the paper. I updated Makefile.
Where are we?
Nothing is waiting on anyone at the moment. We're standardising on including the negative result on implicit language.
Status please.
Got hit by a numerical inconsistency between the abstract and table three in staging.
What if we went with targeting the workshop deadline rather than the main track?
Makes sense, doing that.
Blockers?
The introduction cut from four pages to two went in this morning. I got a first pass at the methodology section over the line. After review I'll deploy.
What landed?
Reporting macro F1 rather than accuracy won the vote. I've locked in framing the contribution as a measurement study. Here's where things stand.
How is an internal architecture RFC going?
See the diff in paper/appendix.tex. CI is passing.
Next steps for an internal architecture RFC?
Citations normalised to a single bibliography style went in this morning. See the diff in paper/related_work.tex. See the diff in paper/abstract.tex.
